newsitem.title: UK: BP's Simon to join Blair government - FT.
newsitem.headline: BP's Simon to join Blair government - FT.

text.p: British Petroleum Co Plc chairman Sir David Simon is to be appointed to a new full-time ministerial post in Tony Blair's government, the Financial Times said on Wednesday.
The newspaper said Simon would be a minister at the Department of Trade and Industry and, after being made a life peer, would be Treasury spokesman in the House of Lords, Parliament's upper chamber.
On Tuesday, a BP spokesman confirmed that Simon was still in talks with Blair's office after earlier being linked in newspaper reports to the post of minister for Europe.
No spokesman for BP was immediately available on Wednesday.
